changes: You can now attach a file, image, or conversation and press Return without typing anything; Omi responds to the attachment directly.
Attached files, images, and conversations are now treated as the subject of your message, so Omi answers about the attachment instead of describing your screen.
Voice typing now capitalizes sentence starts and the pronoun "I" even when the AI cleanup is unavailable
Completed realtime voice conversations now keep their final answer in conversation history
